task_description: Write a method in Dafny to get all lucid numbers smaller than or equal to a given integer.
specification_response:
method GetLucidNumbers(n: int) returns (lucidNumbers: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned sequence contains all lucid numbers less than or equal to n
    - Every number in the sequence is a lucid number
    - All lucid numbers less than or equal to n are included in the sequence
    - The sequence is sorted in ascending order
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method GetLucidNumbers(n: int) returns (result: seq<int>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The input n should be non-negative (since Lucid numbers are non-negative)
    
Dafny specification:
    requires n >= 0
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The result is a sequence of all lucid numbers less than or equal to n, in increasing order
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures forall k :: 0 <= k < |result| ==> result[k] >= 0 && result[k] <= n
    ensures IsSorted(result)
    ensures |result| == n + 1
    ensures result[0] == 0
    ensures result[|result|-1] == n
    
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method GetLucidNumbers(n: int) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures forall k :: 0 <= k < |result| ==> result[k] >= 0 && result[k] <= n
    ensures IsSorted(result)
    ensures |result| == n + 1
    ensures result[0] == 0
    ensures result[|result|-1] == n
{
    var seqBuilder := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i <= n
        invariant 0 <= i <= n + 1
        invariant |seqBuilder| == i
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> seqBuilder[k] == k
    {
        seqBuilder := seqBuilder + [i];
        i := i + 1;
    }
    result := seqBuilder;
}
```
